This '''unidentified Jedi''' was the [[Jedi Master/Legends|master]] to [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Arn Peralun]] during the [[Galactic War|renewed conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. This Jedi was slain on [[Dakot Seven]] while he and his apprentice were escorting [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] to save them from [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]; he was killed when incoming fire rained upon himself and his Padawan.<ref name="Onslaught" />

His apprentice Peralun was struck and suffered serious injuries resulting in him receiving several [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetics]].<ref name="TOR-TUC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Arn Peralun}}</ref>
